1244.title: Barrier
headers: Barrier I
Learn: 3 SP
Cost: X AP
Effect: Absorb up to AP Spent / 2 (rounded down) points of DMG from a Ranged attack or Skill. Can be used outside your Turn. Can be used to reduce the incoming DMG not always stop it fully.
Barrier - Wave of the Hand I
Learn: 3 SP
Cost: X AP
Effect: INSTEAD Barrier costs exactly as much AP as the DMG it prevents, but you must stop the entire incoming attack (ex. 3 incoming DMG costs 3 AP to stop).
Barrier - Wave of the Hand II
Learn: 3 SP
Cost: X AP
Effect: ALSO you can use Barrier any number of times per Round. Spam Penalty still applies.
Barrier - Bulwark I
Learn: 2 SP
Cost: X AP +1 UPKEEP

Effect: INSTEAD Create the Barrier on an adjacent Hex. It can be moved for 1 AP. It will absorb DMG passing through it and acts as Cover. Uses the standard AP spent / 2 (rounded down) formula for determining Hit Points.
Barrier - Bulwark II
Learn: 2 SP
Cost: X AP +1 UPKEEP
Effect: ALSO for every 1 Hit Points the Barrier has, it is 1 Hex longer. You may choose to shape/curve it when creating, and later rotate it instead of moving (still for 1 AP).
Barrier - Riposte II
Learn: 2 SP
Cost: X AP
Effect: ALSO Range increases to 6 Hexes.
Barrier - Riposte III
Learn: 2 SP
Cost: X AP
Effect: INSTEAD After absorbing the DMG, the Barrier strikes back for DMG equal to the total AP spent to initially create it (Range 6 Hexes).
Barrier - Riposte I
Learn: 2 SP
Cost: X AP
Effect: ALSO You may expend extra AP when casting Barrier. After absorbing DMG, the Barrier strikes back for DMG equal to its remaining Hit Points (Range 4 Hexes).
Barrier - Bulwark III
Learn: 2 SP
Cost: X AP
Effect: ALSO the Barrier becomes tangible, and can block passage and both Ranged and Melee Attacks that would pass through it.
